shots.name: 01-overview-desktop
shots.caption: Opening view: orientation only — no artifact body, no artifact-level graph.

shots.name: 02-artifact-detail-desktop
shots.caption: Master-detail: one active artifact, with grouped relationships below its body.

shots.name: 03-relationship-groups-collapsed
shots.caption: The most connected artifact (27 relationships): groups carry exact counts and the large ones start collapsed.

shots.name: 04-relationship-groups-expanded
shots.caption: The same artifact with every group expanded: exactly the counted members appear.

shots.name: 05-artifact-detail-narrow
shots.caption: Narrow viewport: the detail is its own state, reached from the list.

shots.name: 06-artifact-list-narrow
shots.caption: Narrow viewport: the list is its own state, not a compressed desktop layout.

shots.name: 07-long-title-and-body
shots.caption: Long title and body wrap within their container; the page does not scroll sideways.

shots.name: 08-unknown-identifier
shots.caption: An identifier this snapshot does not contain is named, with a way onward.

shots.name: 09-landscape-fitted
shots.caption: The Product Landscape, fitted: four permanently visible bands, every artifact its own titled node, nothing aggregated and nothing hidden.

shots.name: 22-landscape-readable
shots.caption: The same landscape zoomed to readable detail, where each node identifies itself by title with its identifier beneath.

shots.name: 23-landscape-focus-ring
shots.caption: Keyboard focus on a landscape node, with the focus ring visible.

shots.name: 24-landscape-narrow
shots.caption: The landscape on a narrow viewport.

shots.name: 26-landscape-730
shots.caption: The complete landscape at the largest reference scale: 730 artifacts, every one its own node, none aggregated away.

shots.name: 25-landscape-no-colour
shots.caption: The landscape rendered without colour: band and kind remain determinable from text and position.

shots.name: 17-focus-typical
shots.caption: Focused neighbourhood of a typical artifact: outgoing groups above the anchor, incoming below, small groups already open.

shots.name: 18-focus-hardest
shots.caption: The hardest artifact in the model: 27 relationships become 5 satellites, the large ones closed with exact counts.

shots.name: 19-focus-expanded
shots.caption: One satellite opened: its members fan out beside it and every other satellite stays exactly where it was.

shots.name: 20-focus-isolated
shots.caption: An artifact with no relationships says so rather than drawing an empty diagram.

shots.name: 10-focus-visible
shots.caption: Keyboard focus is visible: the focus ring on the first list entry.

shots.name: 11-no-colour
shots.caption: Rendered without colour: kind, status, selection and relationship direction remain determinable.

shots.name: 12-search-ranked
shots.caption: Ranked search for "product": 73 matches, top 25 shown, identifier and title matches above body-only ones.

shots.name: 13-search-snippet
shots.caption: A body match shows a snippet of the matching content, inserted as text.

shots.name: 14-search-keyboard-active
shots.caption: Arrow keys move an active result, reported with aria-activedescendant; Enter follows it.

shots.name: 15-search-no-results
shots.caption: A query matching nothing says so, and repeats the query it searched for.

shots.name: 16-search-narrow
shots.caption: Search results on a narrow viewport.
